name: whatsapp_outbound_messages
description: Replies to inbound WhatsApp messages: an outbox of text parts sent through the Graph API only after the recipient is authorized again for the same Person and link version, and only within the customer service window.
lifecycle: Created when processing produces a reply; sent in part order under a lease; retried only when Meta proves the message was not accepted (rate limits, temporary unavailability); a timeout or lost response becomes unknown and is never resent. Delivery statuses from signed webhooks advance the state. The text is cleared once Meta accepts the part or it reaches a final state. Pruned with its inbound message.

columns.Meaning: Order of the part within the reply (1..20).
Person the reply is for; checked again before sending.
Link version the reply was produced under; a changed or removed link revokes it.
Number to send to, exactly as the sender's message reported it.
columns.Null meaning: The sender reported only the WhatsApp user identifier.

columns.Meaning: WhatsApp business-scoped user identifier used when no number was reported.
answer (agent reply) or notice (channel message such as a command result, unsupported type or limit).
Text of the part while it awaits sending.
columns.Null meaning: Accepted by Meta or final; the reply remains in the agent conversation.

columns.Meaning: pending, sending, accepted, sent, delivered, read, failed, unknown, revoked or expired.
Earliest next attempt after a retryable refusal.
Expiry of the current send claim.
Meta message id of the accepted part; matches delivery status webhooks.
Allowlisted failure, refusal or Meta error code.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (inbound_id) REFERENCES whatsapp_inbound_messages(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (((recipient_phone IS NOT NULL) OR (recipient_user_id IS NOT NULL)))

CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'sending'::character varying, 'accepted'::character varying, 'sent'::character varying, 'delivered'::character varying, 'read'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'unknown'::character varying, 'revoked'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying])::text[])))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whatsapp_outbound_messages_part_key ON public.whatsapp_outbound_messages USING btree (inbound_id, part)
constraints.Purpose: One row per part of a reply.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX whatsapp_outbound_messages_provider_key ON public.whatsapp_outbound_messages USING btree (provider_message_id)
CREATE INDEX whatsapp_outbound_messages_work_idx ON public.whatsapp_outbound_messages USING btree (state, not_before)
